newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paris court says no Eurotunnel statement on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Paris court says no Eurotunnel statement on Monday.

text.p: A Paris commercial court spokesman confirmed on Monday that a mandate for two mediators who have been negotiating a debt restructuring between Eurotunnel SA/Plc and its banks expires at midnight and said no press release would be issued before then.
"If there is a press release, it would only come tomorrow morning," he told Reuters.
Eurotunnel earlier asked for its shares to be suspended in Paris, London and Brussels, to avoid speculation.

The court named in February Robert Badinter and Lord Wakeham as mediators to help a refinancing of Eurotunnel's 72 billion francs of junior bank debt, on which the company froze interest payment last year.
